text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Swissnex est le réseau mondial suisse chargé de tisser des liens dans les domaines de la formation, de la recherche et de l’innovation.", "gist": "Swissnex is the Swiss global network connecting education, research, and innovation"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Notre mission est de soutenir le rayonnement international de nos partenaires ainsi que leur participation active à l’échange mondial de connaissances, d’idées et de talents.", "gist": "Our mission is to support the international visibility of partners and their active participation in global knowledge, ideas, and talent exchange"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swissnex", "gist": "Swissnex (the Swiss global network)"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "six", "gist": "six"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "les six principaux sites Swissnex", "gist": "the six main Swissnex sites"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "les régions les plus innovantes du monde", "gist": "the world's most innovative regions"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "la vingtaine de sections scientifiques et de conseillers scientifiques auprès des ambassades de Suisse", "gist": "around twenty scientific sections and scientific advisors at Swiss embassies"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ils contribuent, en collaboration avec la vingtaine de sections scientifiques et de conseillers scientifiques auprès des ambassades de Suisse, à renforcer la position de la Suisse en tant que pôle mondial de l’innovation.", "gist": "They contribute to strengthening Switzerland's position as a global innovation hub in collaboration with scientific sections and advisors at Swiss embassies"}]}
